title: A counter process and a parallel map
hints: Counter.start: spawn(fn -> loop(initial) end), where loop is a private function with a receive that calls loop again.
For value, send {:value, self()} to the counter, then receive the reply. The counter sends the number back to the pid it was given.
Parallel.map: first start a Task.async for every item, and only then Task.await each of them. Awaiting inside the first map would run them one at a time.
